title: Tim Phillips confirms Borland's two drawings were classified under a security classification guide
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Tim Phillips confirms Borland's two drawings were classified under a security classification guide, about 2023-2025 at AARO, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> and Tim Phillips acknowledged yes Dylan drew two drawings and yes Arrow was told what to classify because of his security classification guide.

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he made two drawings that ended up with AARO, the Pentagon office that handles reports of unidentified aerial phenomena. Borland says that Tim Phillips, connected to that office, acknowledged that Borland drew the two drawings and that the office was told to classify them under a security classification guide, a rulebook saying which information must be kept secret. If so, it would mean his material was treated as sensitive government information.
